name: Keshini
subtitle: Rosemary & Peppermint Men's Thinning Oil
tagline: From India's Roots to Your Roots.
description: A precise, stimulating botanical tonic crafted to awaken sluggish follicles and restore vitality to thinning hair. Keshini blends the crisp clarity of Rosemary and cooling Peppermint with the ancient, root-fortifying power of Bhringraj and Amla. Designed specifically for the nuances of men's scalp health, this lightweight oil encourages vigorous circulation, clears away follicle-blocking congestion, and builds a robust foundation for thicker, denser growth.

ingredients.name: Rosemary
ingredients.role: Dramatically boosts microcirculation to awaken dormant roots

ingredients.name: Peppermint Leaves
ingredients.role: Cools the scalp and clears away buildup that stifles growth

ingredients.name: Bhringraj
ingredients.role: Strengthens the hair shaft and anchors the roots deeply

ingredients.name: Amla
ingredients.role: Delivers essential Vitamin C to protect and nourish the scalp

whyThisHerb: Rosemary is celebrated for its ability to draw fresh blood and oxygen directly to the follicles, while Bhringraj provides the foundational strength required to sustain new, resilient hair.

howToUse.title: Target
howToUse.description: Apply a few drops directly to the scalp, focusing closely on the hairline, crown, and any areas of thinning.

howToUse.title: Stimulate
howToUse.description: Vigorously massage the oil into the skin using your fingertips to encourage blood flow and awaken the roots.

howToUse.title: Activate
howToUse.description: Allow the stimulating botanical blend to sit for at least 30 minutes, enjoying the crisp, cooling sensation.

howToUse.title: Cleanse
howToUse.description: Wash thoroughly with a clarifying shampoo. Use consistently to maintain a healthy environment for growth.
